channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: El banquero, la película y el escándalo que amenaza la candidatura de Bolsonaro hijo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro and a prospective candidate in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, fired his marketing chief last week. He is desperately seeking a photograph he believes could salvage his campaign, which has been shaken by a scandal involving a banker and a film. The situation reveals vulnerability in his candidacy amid rising media and political pressure.

item.title: CNJ pode votar nesta terça proposta de Fachin de contracheque único para controlar penduricalhos
item.description: The National Justice Council (CNJ) may vote on Tuesday on a proposal by Supreme Court President Luiz Edson Fachin to introduce a single paycheck for judges. The initiative aims to consolidate all compensation — salary, bonuses, extra payments, daily allowances, and indemnifications — into one document to enhance transparency and curb 'penduricalhos,' or irregular supplementary payments. It also calls for a Unified Remuneration Table (TRU) and gives courts 60 days to comply, following an audit that found over 35 million in irregular penduricalhos paid by the Goiás Court of Justice between March and May 2026.

item.title: Governo publica decreto que fixa em R$ 0,44 subsídio por litro da gasolina
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a decree establishing a subsidy of R$0.44 per liter for gasoline, effective for two months, to counteract the impact of rising oil prices due to the Middle East war. The subsidy will be paid directly to producers and importers via the ANP. This measure is part of a broader government package to curb fuel price increases, which also includes subsidies for diesel, cooking gas, aviation kerosene, and tax benefits.

item.title: Nunes Marques propõe regras para o uso de IA nas eleições
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, established in a meeting with TRE presidents a 30-day deadline for all regional electoral courts to create information security units, aiming to protect the electoral process from cyberattacks. He also created a permanent 90-day committee to regulate the use of AI in elections, including university partnerships, administrative and jurisdictional norms, and party compliance. The agenda further addressed logistics for disabled voters, support for indigenous peoples, and expansion of affirmative policies for women and Black individuals within the Electoral Justice system.

item.title: Frias nega ao STF uso de emenda para filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) denied before the STF the use of parliamentary amendments to finance the film 'Dark Horse', stating the funds were allocated to digital inclusion, entrepreneurship, and sports projects. He dismissed the allegations of public fund misappropriation as false and defamatory, citing opinions from Conof and the Chamber’s chief lawyer that found no formal or material irregularities. The investigation was triggered by a complaint from Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP) following Intercept Brasil’s revelations about Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s private fundraising efforts for the film.

item.title: Federação União-PP considera improvável apoio a Flávio após caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Leaders of the União-PP federation consider it unlikely to formally support Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential candidacy following revelations about his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The 'Dark Horse' case raised concerns about conflicts of interest and banking influence in the campaign. The federation aims to distance itself from potential controversies that could harm its electoral image.

item.title: Relembre a trajetória médica de Lula ao longo dos anos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a radiotherapy session as part of preventive treatment following the removal of a skin cancer lesion from his head in late April. He is scheduled to complete 14 additional sessions over the next three weeks. The procedure is considered routine, with no indications of worsening health.

item.title: Redes de Lula serão geridas pelo PT para amplificar ofensiva contra adversários
item.description: President Lula will adopt a more combative stance on social media in the coming weeks, as the management of his personal accounts is transferred from the federal government’s Secom to the PT. This shift aims to enable more forceful political engagement, free from the constraints of official government communication.

item.title: Comissão adia votação da PEC do fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: The special committee in the Chamber postponed the vote on the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, establishing a constitutional right to two weekly rest days and a maximum 40-hour workweek without salary reduction. The report was presented after a meeting between Lula and Hugo Motta, and the request for additional analysis time was made by Deputy Mauricio Marcon (PL-RS). The new rules do not apply to workers with a university degree and a monthly salary equal to or above 2.5 times the INSS ceiling, except for public servants.

item.title: “A esquerda tem dificuldade em falar de família”, diz Tebet
item.description: Former Planning Minister Simone Tebet (PSB-SP) said the left struggles to talk about family, despite acknowledging that President Lula’s government runs the largest social programs benefiting families, such as Bolsa Família and housing initiatives. She urged dialogue with new societal demands, especially among Brazilian women entrepreneurs, to reclaim political narrative and voter support.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: pedido de vista adia votação de PEC que prevê redução de jornada para 40 horas
item.description: A request for a view by federal deputy Mauricio Marcon (PL-RS) postponed the vote on the PEC that reduces the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without salary cuts, to be implemented within up to 14 months after promulgation. Reporter Léo Prates (Republicanos-BA) presented a one-year transition agreement, including a two-phase reduction and the end of the 6x1 scale with at least two weekly days off guaranteed after 60 days. The expected vote is in the special committee on Wednesday (27) and in the plenary on Thursday (28), requiring at least 308 deputies and 49 senators for approval.

item.title: Frias rebate STF e nega que emendas financiaram ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) denied before the Supreme Federal Court that parliamentary funds he directed to an NGO financed the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic about former president Jair Bolsonaro. He requested the case be closed, calling the allegations unfounded.

item.title: Lula toma decisão sobre ajuda à Bolívia em meio à onda de protestos no país
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva authorized humanitarian aid to Bolivia following a wave of protests that caused shortages in several regions. The decision came after a phone call with Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz, who also announced a 50% cut in his own and ministers’ salaries. Lula emphasized the importance of dialogue and respect for democratic institutions to avoid violence and preserve social peace.

item.title: Brasil enviará ajuda humanitária para a Bolívia
item.description: President Lula ordered humanitarian aid for Bolivia following a call with President Rodrigo Paz, amid protests causing shortages of food, fuel, and oxygen due to gasoline subsidy cuts. The aid targets regions affected by road blockades and service disruptions, including hospitals. Lula emphasized the importance of democratic institutions and dialogue to resolve the crisis.

item.title: Congresso compra votos e decide em causa própria, descaradamente, em ano eleitoral
item.description: Congress approved the transition to end the 6x1 work scale by 2027, while simultaneously cutting nearly 40% of the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará to benefit agribusiness at the environment's expense. It also allowed federal transfers to municipalities during an election year, constituting a blatant vote-buying scheme using public funds to reward allied mayors, while the STF reviews reducing ineligibility periods for corrupt politicians like Sérgio Cabral. These actions reveal a pattern where PT, PL and Centrão candidates prioritize personal and partisan gain over national interest.

item.title: SEM CENSURA E SEM AUDIÊNCIA: entrevista de Lula à Tv Brasil fica em último no Ibope
item.description: President Lula's interview on Tv Brasil, despite being broadcast on the public network and partner channels, recorded the lowest Ibope rating, highlighting chronic difficulties in audience attraction and distribution for the government broadcaster.

item.title: Valdemar contradiz Flávio sobre visita a Vorcaro após 1ª prisão
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to Daniel Vorcaro during his house arrest was aimed at obtaining the remaining funds for the film 'Dark Horse', contradicting Flávio's claim that the meeting was merely to conclude their relationship. Valdemar said he was unaware of the connection until the scandal broke, but defended the action as normal and insisted it does not affect Flávio's presidential candidacy.

item.title: DECEPÇÃO? Joaquim Barbosa estreia com apenas 2% nas pesquisas pelo DC
item.description: The Christian Democracy (DC) party officially launched Joaquim Barbosa, former Supreme Court justice, as its candidate, but his debut in opinion polls was disappointing, with only 2% voter intention. The low initial support has raised concerns among party leaders about the campaign’s viability and potential to gain momentum. The key question now is whether Barbosa still has the political strength to rise or if his candidacy is already doomed from the start.

item.title: Mário Frias diz a Dino que não enviou emendas para financiar filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) denied to Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino that he sent parliamentary amendments to finance the producer of the Bolsonaro biopic, calling the allegations of R$ 2 million in misappropriated funds false and speculative. He stated his funds were directed toward digital inclusion, entrepreneurship, and sports projects, with no evidence of diversion to the film. Prior to his submission, a court officer attempted to serve him five times without success, as he was abroad without Chamber authorization.

item.title: Aécio Neves: Combato o PT, mas Lula não é meu inimigo
item.description: Aécio Neves stated that he has opposed the PT long before Bolsonaro became a national figure, but clarified that this does not mean he treats President Lula as an enemy. He emphasized his role as PSDB leader and federal deputy, maintaining criticism of the party while avoiding personalizing his opposition against Lula.

item.title: Lula conversa com presidente da Bolívia, que enfrenta crise política
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) held a phone conversation with Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz amid the country's political crisis, marked by protests and road blockades demanding his resignation. The dialogue takes place against a backdrop of internal turmoil in Bolivia, with Lula seeking to preserve diplomatic channels.

item.title: 'É irresponsabilidade sem precedentes', diz dirigente de associação sobre mudança na escala 6x1
item.description: The bar and restaurant sector had anticipated the government's proposal to end the 6x1 work scale, but criticized the agreement between Lula and Hugo Motta as irresponsible and unprecedented. The change in work schedule was seen as harmful, despite being expected. The association's leader described the measure as an unprecedented lack of responsibility in the sector.

item.title: Presidentes do TSE e dos TREs discutem medidas para proteger processo eleitoral de 2026
item.description: The president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Nunes Marques, presented measures to protect the 2026 electoral process to the presidents of the Regional Electoral Courts (TREs), including the establishment of information security units in all TREs within 30 days, modeled after São Paulo and Goiás. The meeting also addressed cybersecurity and the use of artificial intelligence in elections, with participation from Minister André Mendonça, vice-president of the TSE.

item.title: Mário Frias diz ao STF que emendas para ONG ligada à produtora de filme sobre Bolsonaro não foram direcionadas para a obra
item.description: Federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) denied to the STF that the R$1 million in parliamentary amendments he directed to the Instituto Conhecer Brasil (ICB) were used to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, stating the funds were allocated to digital inclusion, literacy, entrepreneurship, and sports projects for vulnerable youth. The investigation was initiated by Minister Flávio Dino following a complaint by deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), who alleged 'triangulation' of public funds for the movie's production. Frias also requested the case's dismissal, arguing there is no evidence of misappropriation and that the Chamber's Budget Consultancy validated the amendments' allocation.

item.title: Crise com Marcelão expõe desordem na pré-campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The tumultuous departure of advisor Marcello Lopes, known as Marcelão, exposed internal disorder and conflict in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign following the release of audios linking the senator to ex-banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. Marcelão, a former police officer with ties to government contracts under Jair Bolsonaro, accused team members of leaks, engaged in physical aggression and office destruction before being fired. The crisis was escalated to the PL leadership, with Senator Rogério Marinho involved in the decision to remove him.

item.title: Defesa de Mário Frias nega triangulação de emendas para produção do filme Dark Horse
item.description: The defense of Deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) denied before STF Minister Flávio Dino that there was triangulation of parliamentary amendments to fund the film Dark Horse, stating the accusation is speculative and lacks proof, citing a technical opinion from the Chamber that found compatibility between the amendments' objects and their execution, even though the accountability phase is still ongoing.

item.title: Estrago para Flavio foi pequeno, mas pode piorar
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll confirms Flavio Bolsonaro's decline after audio leaks with Daniel Vorcaro, showing a technical tie with Lula but an expanded lead for the incumbent. While the damage so far has been minor, new developments — such as alleged misappropriation of film funds to support Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S. or irregular payments to Mario Frias — could worsen the crisis. Plea bargains may also reveal further details, possibly involving Lula.

item.title: União Brasil é o 1º partido a inspecionar códigos-fonte dos sistemas das Eleições 2026
item.description: União Brasil became the first political party to inspect the source code of the electoral systems to be used in the 2026 General Elections, during an activity held at the TSE headquarters in Brasília. The inspection is part of the Electoral Justice’s Democratic Transparency Cycle, allowing party representatives to access the technical environment to analyze system functionality and clarify doubts with the TSE’s Secretariat of Information Technology team.

item.title: Após conversa com Rodrigo Paz, Lula determina envio de ajuda humanitária à Bolívia
item.description: After a phone call with Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz, Lula determined the sending of humanitarian aid to Bolivia in response to protests causing shortages and social tensions. The protests, led by miners', peasants', and residents' unions, demand wage increases, quality fuel, and criticize Paz's liberal economic policy, with annual inflation at 14% in April. Lula reiterated solidarity with the Bolivian government, defended respect for democratic institutions, and advocated dialogue as the path to resolve the crisis.

item.title: Lula conversa com presidente da Bolívia em meio a protestos e bloqueios e envia ajuda humanitária ao país
item.description: President Lula spoke with Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz regarding protests and road blockades in Bolivia, ordering humanitarian aid without specifying types or timelines. He stressed respect for democratic institutions, dialogue as the path to resolve the crisis, and the need to avoid violence and preserve social peace. Paz faces pressure from indigenous groups, farmers, and miners for three weeks amid Bolivia's worst economic crisis in forty years.

item.title: O acordo para aprovar o fim da 6x1 na Câmara: o que falta definir na proposta
item.description: The agreement between Chamber President Hugo Motta and President Lula establishes a transition to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours in two steps: first to 42 hours after 60 days of promulgation, then to 40 hours after an additional year. The requirement for at least two days off per week takes effect after 60 days, with no salary reduction. The PEC is expected to be voted in the Chamber this week, but its progress in the Senate remains uncertain due to the lack of commitment from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Lula atende a pedido de presidente e envia ajuda em meio à onda de protestos na Bolívia, diz Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded to a request from Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz by authorizing humanitarian aid to Bolivia amid the fourth week of protests against the government. Demonstrators have blocked roads and demanded agrarian policy reforms, better fuel quality, and even the president’s resignation. Lula emphasized the importance of democratic institutions, the rule of law, and dialogue to prevent violence and preserve social peace.

item.title: Governo Lula estuda estender subvenções ao diesel
item.description: The Lula government is studying the extension or expansion of diesel subsidies to mitigate the impact of the Middle East war on fuel prices. Minister Márcio Elias Rosa confirmed that measures such as PIS/Cofins zero-rating and subsidies of up to R$1.52 per liter have already been applied and may be reinstated if needed, without ruling out further increases to protect vulnerable productive sectors.

item.title: Mario Frias nega que emenda para ONG ligada à produtora do filme de Bolsonaro foi para 'qualquer produção cinematográfica'
item.description: Deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) denied before the STF that he allocated parliamentary amendments to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, calling the claim false and without evidence. He stated that the R$ 2 million in two amendments were directed to the Instituto Conhecer Brasil, an NGO linked to the film's producer, for projects in digital inclusion, literacy, entrepreneurship, and sports for socially vulnerable youth. The defense noted that a technical analysis by the Chamber found no irregularities and requested the archiving of the investigation, labeling the accusations as speculative and based solely on journalistic reports.

item.title: STF discute com governo Lula notificação de Moraes nos EUA
item.description: The STF has established a communication channel with the AGU and the Ministry of Justice to monitor a U.S. lawsuit against Justice Alexandre de Moraes, alleging violations of the First Amendment over content removals tied to Bolsonaro allies. A U.S. federal judge authorized email notification after diplomatic channels failed, but denied a request to immediately suspend Moraes’ rulings. The STF maintains that Brazilian judges cannot be held personally liable for judicial acts, with responsibility falling on the Brazilian State.

item.title: Valdemar diz que Flávio visitou Vorcaro para 'ver se conseguia o resto do dinheiro' de filme
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited banker Daniel Vorcaro in November 2025 to try to secure the remaining funding for a film, contradicting Bolsonaro’s own version of the visit’s purpose. The meeting occurred after Vorcaro’s first arrest by the Federal Police, linked to investigations into Banco Master.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara começa a analisar relatório do fim da jornada 6X1
item.description: The Special Committee of the Chamber of Deputies began analyzing the report by Deputy Leo Prates (Republicanos-BA), proposing to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, with a 60-day transition period after the PEC's promulgation. The agreement between the Executive and the Chamber establishes that in the first 60 days, the workweek will drop from 44 to 42 hours, and after 12 months, reach 40 hours (5x2 schedule). The measure responds to workers' demands while allowing time for productive sectors to adapt.

item.title: Valdemar contradiz Flávio e afirma que senador foi a Vorcaro buscar mais dinheiro para filme; esquerda e aliados repercutem
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, contradicted Flávio Bolsonaro by stating that the senator went to Daniel Vorcaro’s house to seek additional funding for the film 'Dark Horse'. Flávio claims the meeting was only to 'put a final point' on sponsorship negotiations. The left and allies reacted, intensifying doubts about the viability of his candidacy.

item.title: Lula e Motta alinharam ‘gordurinha para queimar’ em PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula and House Speaker Hugo Motta agreed to a one-year transition period for the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule — far below the two to three years expected by Motta’s allies. This deliberately short timeframe was described as a 'fat to burn' — a strategic concession designed to prevent Congress from extending the transition significantly during deliberations, as both anticipate the text will be lengthened. The move reflects a tacit agreement to control the reform’s pace, favoring the Executive’s preferred timeline.

item.title: Jornada de 40 horas, transição de um ano e dois dias de folga: veja detalhes do texto da Câmara que prevê o fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The PEC proposed by Deputy Leo Prates aims to end the 6x1 work scale, reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours with two paid days off per week, without salary reduction. The change will be implemented in two phases: a reduction to 42 hours within 60 days of promulgation and to 40 hours after 12 months. The agreement between Lula and Hugo Motta ensures the vote will take place in the Chamber this week.

item.title: Convocado pela Colômbia, Andrés Gómez quebra jejum do Vasco em Copas do Mundo
item.description: Andrés Gómez, Vasco's forward, has been called up by Colombia for the 2026 World Cup, ending an eight-year drought without Vasco players in the tournament. The last Vasco player to appear was goalkeeper Martín Silva in 2014, while the last outfield player was Ricardo Rocha, who won with Brazil in 1994. Other Vasco-linked players with potential call-ups include Puma Rodriguez (Uruguay) and Rayan, a Vasco academy product now at Bournemouth, selected by Carlo Ancelotti for Brazil.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara analisa PEC que prevê o fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies began analyzing a PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours with two days off, while maintaining current salaries. The proposal includes an immediate two-hour reduction after 60 days of promulgation and another two-hour reduction within 12 months, based on an agreement between Lula and Hugo Motta. The text also includes adjustments for public servants, service providers, and MEIs to allow additional hiring under the reduced workweek.

item.title: Relembre os problemas de saúde de Lula, que passará por radioterapia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will undergo 15 preventive radiotherapy sessions following the removal of a basal cell lesion on his scalp in April. This adds to a history of at least 14 medical procedures, including a finger amputation in 1964 and larynx cancer treatment in 2011. His health is a topic of debate ahead of the 2026 elections, as re-election would see him turn 85 by the end of his term.

item.title: Marinho pede ao STF que investigue vazamento de áudio Flávio-Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, requested Minister André Mendonça of the STF to open a formal procedure to investigate the leak of audio from the Banco Master inquiry. The material, published by Intercept Brasil, contains excerpts of conversations involving Flávio Bolsonaro and former aide Fabrício Queiroz (the reference to 'Vorcaro' appears to be a common misstatement; the correct name is Queiroz). The representation asks the STF to determine responsibility for the illegal disclosure of confidential data.

item.title: Valdemar diz que Flávio visitou Vorcaro para ‘ver se conseguia o resto do dinheiro’ de filme
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro visited Daniel Vorcaro in November 2025 to collect the remaining payment for the film 'Dark Horse', contradicting the senator’s version that the meeting was to 'put an end to the story'. Valdemar said the visit was normal given the need for financing and affirmed he would support Flávio’s presidential candidacy even if he had known about the relationship with Vorcaro earlier.

item.title: Governo deve decidir sobre aumento do etanol na gasolina em junho
item.description: The government is expected to approve in June an increase in the mandatory ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32% (E32), pending deliberation by the CNPE. Industry Minister Márcio Elias Rosa stated the measure was already announced by the Planalto and faces no expected opposition, citing advanced technical tests and rising fossil fuel prices. The change, provided for in the Future Fuel Law, aims to boost biofuels' share in the national market.

item.title: Policiais rodoviários pedem a Alcolumbre tramitação da PEC da Segurança
item.description: The FenaPRF and other public security entities sent a letter to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre requesting the initial processing of the Public Security PEC (PEC 18/2025), which has been stalled since March 10. The proposal, approved in two rounds by the Chamber on March 4, 2026, aims to modernize the public security system, valorize professionals, and address police pensions and retirement. President Lula also urged Alcolumbre to advance the proposal for voting, calling it a Planalto priority ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Zema diz que quem votar em Flávio Bolsonaro entregará eleição a Lula; Caiado defende união
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president from the Novo Party, said the Banco Master scandal has made the electoral landscape more difficult for the right and warned that voting for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would likely hand Lula (PT) another four years in office. He urged unity among right-wing forces to prevent this outcome.

item.title: “Michelle está fora de questão. Ela não é candidata”, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the Liberal Party, stated that Michelle Bolsonaro will not be a presidential candidate in 2026 and that the party will maintain Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-candidacy, despite controversies surrounding the senator’s ties to Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Em primeira pesquisa, Joaquim Barbosa tem desempenho inexpressivo
item.description: Retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa received only 2% voting intention in the first electoral poll featuring his name. 48% of respondents said they did not know the magistrate, reflecting low public recognition. The result was discussed on the Papo Antagonista program this Monday, the 25th.
